obligations.definition: The task includes four Gray synchronization contexts, combinational encoding/decoding, reset synchronization, two-stage handshake buffering, debug serial output, and the remaining CDC variants; there are no CPU interface or processor instruction obligations. See the interface contract for port aliases and fixed parameters.
obligations.setup: Establish known legal inputs and the necessary reset/history according to the interface contract; internal signals must not be forced.
obligations.stimulus: Independently drive all public functional roots and separately observe each native output; CPU instructions or nonexistent CPU ports are not required. Keep the inputs of each domain independent, and jointly check the four Gray contexts and all auxiliary roots.
obligations.expected: The task includes four Gray synchronization contexts, combinational encoding/decoding, reset synchronization, two-stage handshake buffering, debug serial output, and the remaining CDC variants; there are no CPU interface or processor instruction obligations. See the interface contract for port aliases and fixed parameters.
obligations.sampling: Stable before the accepting edge of each native clock, with observations 2ns and 8ns after the edge; combinational inputs likewise use 2ns and 8ns settling windows.
obligations.checker: Independently compute expected values using only resets, inputs, and their histories; do not read DUT actual to generate expected. Inputs must be stable at least 2ns before the accepting edge; compare all valid outputs 2ns and 8ns after each event, and report UVM_ERROR on any four-state inequality. obligations.definition: For WIDTH=1, 2, or 4, the source-domain rising edge captures the current Gray encoding; each destination-domain rising edge advances the DEST_SYNC_FF-stage synchronization history. When REG_OUTPUT is 1, the binary decoding is output only after one additional destination rising edge. In the fixed WIDTH=1, DEST_SYNC_FF=2, REG_OUTPUT=0 context, Gray encoding and decoding both preserve the bit: each captured 0 or 1 appears after two destination rising edges. Coincident source and destination rising edges use the previous source capture. There is no reset or handshake, and the power-up history is unknown; enough effective source/destination edges must be allowed for convergence. No modeling of metastability behavior is promised.
obligations.setup: Establish known legal inputs and the necessary reset/history according to the interface contract; internal signals must not be forced.
obligations.stimulus: The source/destination clocks of the four Gray groups are individually independent. Traverse the full two-state input space for each group, varying source-fast/destination-slow, source-slow/destination-fast, and coincident-edge phases separately; save the complete input captured on each source edge, shift it out according to each destination-edge history, and check unconverged X values and converged values cycle by cycle. For WIDTH=1, check both captured 0 and 1 after two destination edges, including coincident source/destination edges; check the additional latency only for instances with REG_OUTPUT=1.

obligations.definition: Non-bypass instances have a two-slot capacity, and active-low asynchronous reset clears occupancy and data. ready_o is 0 only when both slots are full; valid_o indicates that at least one slot is full, and older data is output first; flush cancels occupancy and must not be asserted simultaneously with valid. The valid/data/ready signals of the bypass instance are directly and transparently connected, and neither flush nor reset changes this relationship.
obligations.setup: Establish known legal inputs and the necessary reset/history according to the interface contract; internal signals must not be forced.
obligations.stimulus: For spill and flush, sequentially exercise empty, single-item, and two-item filling, downstream blocking, rejection when full, simultaneous enqueue/dequeue, draining, and reset; assert flush only when valid_i=0. Maintain a capacity-2 FIFO queue on each accepting edge, compare data_o only when valid_o is asserted, and compare valid_o/ready_o at each point. Combinationally change bypass valid/data/ready and check that reset does not change the transparent relationship.

obligations.definition: Synchronous active-high rst clears the history; after detecting a PC change, mode/PC/instruction/writeback data are captured, and a sequence starting with the low nibble is output cycle by cycle. Modes 0/1/2 serialize 8/16/24 nibbles, respectively; no recapture occurs while busy. Mode 3 follows the PC nibble-selection path but has no mode termination condition; return values beyond the selectable range must still be checked according to the fixed RTL four-state semantics.

Change inputs while busy to confirm that no recapture occurs, and check the new PC after busy ends. Hold mode3 for more than 32 cycles, check X output beyond 8 nibbles and 5-bit counter wraparound, then reset to exit.
